quantity.description: Quantity in the item base unit.
Requested quantity in base units, decimal string.

unit_cost.description: Recorded local-currency item unit cost, decimal string.

estimated_cost.description: quantity multiplied by unit_cost, decimal string; no currency rounding applied.

forecast_stock.description: Calculate an explainable company-wide baseline from completed historical Sale ledger movements and current inventory. Includes Sale returns, excludes incoming supply, open commitments, seasonality and production. Fails on incomplete history.

tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID for this Business Central environment.

environment.description: Business Central Online environment name, such as Sandbox or Production.

forecast_days.description: Forecast calendar days from the current stock snapshot.

snapshot_at.description: UTC timestamp of the current-stock snapshot.

net_sales_quantity.description: Negative sum of Sale quantities, including returns; decimal string.

current_inventory.description: Current company-wide inventory in base units; decimal string.

average_daily_demand.description: Nonnegative net sales divided by all calendar days in the history; decimal string.

forecast_demand.description: Average daily demand multiplied by forecast_days; decimal string.

projected_inventory.description: Current inventory minus baseline forecast demand; decimal string.

days_of_cover.description: Nonnegative stock divided by average daily demand, or null when demand is zero.
